name: Breach, The Dividing Blade

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus : +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Shrieking
effects.tooltip: Shrieking : Shrieking weapons emit a piercing screech whenever they are used to make a successful attack. This screech deals an additional 2 to 12 sonic damage.

effects.name: Disintegration
effects.tooltip: Disintegration : This weapon has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies and attempts to disintegrate them.

effects.name: Shatter
effects.tooltip: Shatter +10 : This effect gives a +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Sunder and Improved Sunder attempts.

effects.name: Doublestrike
effects.tooltip: Doublestrike 6% : Passive: 6% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)

flavor_text: This massive falchion has emerged in most of the Realm' notable conflicts in the past century. How it finds its way into the hands of so many different bearers is unknown, but when brought into battle, few can stand against its power.

source.raw: Caught in the Web , End Chest
